_meta.name: MedInfer AI knowledge base
_meta.note: Single source of truth for the expert system content. medical_kb.pl facts are generated from this file by generate_kb.py.

flu.description: Influenza is a viral infection that attacks the respiratory system. It is highly contagious and spreads through droplets.
flu.recommendation: Rest, stay hydrated, take antiviral medications if prescribed, and isolate to prevent spreading.

cold.description: The common cold is a viral infection of the upper respiratory tract. It is usually mild and self-limiting.
cold.recommendation: Rest, drink warm fluids, use saline nasal drops, and take over-the-counter cold remedies.

covid19.description: COVID-19 is a respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. It can range from mild to severe and is highly contagious.
covid19.recommendation: Isolate immediately, monitor oxygen levels, seek medical attention if breathing becomes difficult.

malaria.description: Malaria is a parasitic disease transmitted through mosquito bites. It causes recurrent fever and can be life-threatening.
malaria.recommendation: Seek immediate medical treatment, take antimalarial drugs, and use mosquito nets.

dengue.description: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing severe flu-like symptoms and sometimes hemorrhagic fever.
dengue.recommendation: Seek medical care, stay hydrated, avoid aspirin, and monitor platelet count.

typhoid.description: Typhoid fever is a bacterial infection caused by Salmonella typhi, spread through contaminated food and water.
typhoid.recommendation: Consult a doctor for antibiotics, maintain hygiene, and drink only boiled water.

migraine.description: Migraine is a neurological condition causing intense, debilitating headaches often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light.
migraine.recommendation: Rest in a dark room, avoid triggers, take prescribed migraine medication.

asthma.description: Asthma is a chronic respiratory condition causing airway inflammation and narrowing, leading to breathing difficulties.
asthma.recommendation: Use inhaler as prescribed, avoid triggers, and seek emergency care if breathing worsens.

pneumonia.description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
pneumonia.recommendation: Seek medical attention, take prescribed antibiotics, rest, and stay hydrated.

diabetes.description: Diabetes is a metabolic disorder characterized by high blood sugar levels over a prolonged period.
diabetes.recommendation: Monitor blood sugar regularly, follow a diabetic diet, exercise, and take prescribed medication.

hypertension.description: Hypertension or high blood pressure is a chronic condition where blood pressure in the arteries is elevated.
hypertension.recommendation: Reduce salt intake, exercise regularly, manage stress, and take prescribed medication.

anemia.description: Anemia is a condition where the body lacks enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen to tissues.
anemia.recommendation: Increase iron-rich foods, take iron supplements, and consult a doctor for underlying causes.

allergy.description: Allergies are immune system reactions to foreign substances that are typically harmless to most people.
allergy.recommendation: Avoid allergens, take antihistamines, and use nasal sprays for relief.

chickenpox.description: Chickenpox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy rash with small fluid-filled blisters.
chickenpox.recommendation: Isolate, avoid scratching, use calamine lotion, and take fever reducers.

measles.description: Measles is a highly contagious viral infection causing a distinctive red rash, fever, and cough.
measles.recommendation: Isolate, rest, stay hydrated, and seek medical care for complications.

hepatitis_a.description: Hepatitis A is a viral liver infection transmitted through contaminated food or water.
hepatitis_a.recommendation: Rest, avoid alcohol, eat a balanced diet, and consult a doctor.

tuberculosis.description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs and spreads through airborne droplets.
tuberculosis.recommendation: Seek immediate medical treatment, complete full antibiotic course, and isolate initially.

bronchitis.description: Bronchitis is inflammation of the bronchial tubes, causing persistent cough with mucus.
bronchitis.recommendation: Rest, stay hydrated, use a humidifier, and avoid smoke exposure.

sinusitis.description: Sinusitis is inflammation of the sinuses, usually caused by infection, leading to facial pain and congestion.
sinusitis.recommendation: Use saline nasal irrigation, steam inhalation, and decongestants.

urinary_tract_infection.description: UTI is a bacterial infection in any part of the urinary system, most commonly the bladder.
urinary_tract_infection.recommendation: Drink plenty of water, urinate frequently, and take prescribed antibiotics.

gastroenteritis.description: Gastroenteritis is inflammation of the stomach and intestines, causing diarrhea and vomiting.
gastroenteritis.recommendation: Stay hydrated with oral rehydration solutions, eat bland foods, and rest.

heat_stroke.description: Heat stroke is a severe heat-related illness occurring when body temperature rises rapidly and the body cannot cool down.
heat_stroke.recommendation: Move to a cool place, apply cold water, seek emergency medical care immediately.

insomnia.description: Insomnia is a sleep disorder characterized by difficulty falling or staying asleep.
insomnia.recommendation: Maintain regular sleep schedule, avoid screens before bed, and practice relaxation.

depression.description: Depression is a mental health disorder causing persistent feelings of sadness and loss of interest.
depression.recommendation: Seek professional counseling, maintain social connections, and consider therapy.

arthritis.description: Arthritis is inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness that worsens with age.
arthritis.recommendation: Exercise gently, apply heat/cold therapy, and consult a rheumatologist.

gerd.description: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a chronic condition where stomach acid frequently flows back into the esophagus, causing irritation.
gerd.recommendation: Avoid trigger foods, eat smaller meals, elevate head while sleeping, and take antacids or proton pump inhibitors.

tension_headache.description: Tension headaches are the most common type of headache, causing a dull, aching sensation all over the head.
tension_headache.recommendation: Rest, manage stress, take over-the-counter pain relievers, and practice relaxation techniques.

mononucleosis.description: Mononucleosis (mono) is a viral infection caused by Epstein-Barr virus, causing fever, sore throat, and swollen glands.
mononucleosis.recommendation: Rest, stay hydrated, avoid strenuous activity, and manage symptoms with pain relievers.

conjunctivitis.description: Conjunctivitis (pink eye) is inflammation of the conjunctiva, causing red, itchy, and sometimes discharge from the eye.
conjunctivitis.recommendation: Avoid touching eyes, wash hands frequently, use prescribed eye drops, and avoid sharing towels.

otitis_media.description: Otitis media is an infection of the middle ear, causing ear pain, fever, and sometimes hearing loss.
otitis_media.recommendation: Seek medical attention for antibiotics, manage pain with OTC pain relievers, and apply warm compresses.

laryngitis.description: Laryngitis is inflammation of the voice box (larynx), causing hoarseness and voice loss.
laryngitis.recommendation: Rest your voice, stay hydrated, use a humidifier, and avoid irritants like smoke.

appendicitis.description: Appendicitis is inflammation of the appendix, a medical emergency requiring immediate surgical removal.
appendicitis.recommendation: Seek emergency medical care immediately. Do not eat or drink anything. Surgery is required.

kidney_stones.description: Kidney stones are hard deposits of minerals and salts that form inside the kidneys, causing severe pain.
kidney_stones.recommendation: Seek medical attention, drink plenty of fluids, and take pain medication. Large stones may require surgery.

stroke.description: Stroke occurs when blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted, causing brain cell death. It is a medical emergency.
stroke.recommendation: Call emergency services immediately. Time is critical. Note the time symptoms started.

heart_attack.description: Myocardial infarction (heart attack) occurs when blood flow to the heart muscle is blocked, causing tissue damage.
heart_attack.recommendation: Call emergency services immediately. Chew aspirin if not allergic. Do not drive yourself to hospital.

copd.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a progressive lung disease causing breathing difficulties.
copd.recommendation: Quit smoking, use prescribed inhalers, attend pulmonary rehabilitation, and avoid lung irritants.

hypothyroidism.description: Hypothyroidism is an underactive thyroid gland that doesn't produce enough thyroid hormones, slowing metabolism.
hypothyroidism.recommendation: Take thyroid hormone replacement medication as prescribed, and get regular blood tests.

hyperthyroidism.description: Hyperthyroidism is an overactive thyroid gland producing too much thyroid hormone, speeding up metabolism.
hyperthyroidism.recommendation: Take anti-thyroid medication, radioactive iodine therapy, or surgery as recommended by your doctor.

gout.description: Gout is a form of inflammatory arthritis caused by excess uric acid in the blood, causing sudden severe joint pain.
gout.recommendation: Take anti-inflammatory medication, avoid high-purine foods, stay hydrated, and rest the affected joint.

fibromyalgia.description: Fibromyalgia is a chronic condition causing widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, and cognitive difficulties.
fibromyalgia.recommendation: Exercise regularly, manage stress, take prescribed medications, and maintain good sleep hygiene.

ibs.description: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) is a chronic gastrointestinal disorder causing abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits.
ibs.recommendation: Follow a low-FODMAP diet, manage stress, exercise regularly, and use prescribed medications.

diverticulitis.description: Diverticulitis is inflammation or infection of small pouches (diverticula) that develop in the colon.
diverticulitis.recommendation: Seek medical attention, take prescribed antibiotics, follow a liquid diet initially, then high-fiber diet.

pancreatitis.description: Pancreatitis is inflammation of the pancreas, which can be acute or chronic, causing severe abdominal pain.
pancreatitis.recommendation: Seek emergency care for acute pancreatitis. Stop alcohol, follow a low-fat diet, and take prescribed medications.

cholecystitis.description: Cholecystitis is inflammation of the gallbladder, usually caused by gallstones blocking the bile duct.
cholecystitis.recommendation: Seek medical care, follow a low-fat diet, and surgery may be required to remove the gallbladder.

lupus.description: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) is a chronic autoimmune disease where the immune system attacks healthy tissue.
lupus.recommendation: Take immunosuppressive medication, avoid sun exposure, manage fatigue, and see a rheumatologist regularly.

rheumatoid_arthritis.description: Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune disorder where the immune system attacks joint linings, causing painful swelling.
rheumatoid_arthritis.recommendation: Take disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs), exercise gently, and consult a rheumatologist.

multiple_sclerosis.description: Multiple sclerosis is an autoimmune disease affecting the central nervous system, disrupting communication between brain and body.
multiple_sclerosis.recommendation: Take disease-modifying therapies, manage symptoms with physical therapy, and avoid heat exposure.

parkinsons.description: Parkinson's disease is a progressive nervous system disorder affecting movement, causing tremors and stiffness.
parkinsons.recommendation: Take dopamine-enhancing medications, exercise regularly, and work with a neurologist.

epilepsy.description: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder causing recurrent seizures due to abnormal electrical activity in the brain.
epilepsy.recommendation: Take anti-epileptic medications as prescribed, avoid seizure triggers, and get adequate sleep.

chronic_fatigue_syndrome.description: Chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a complex disorder causing extreme fatigue that doesn't improve with rest.
chronic_fatigue_syndrome.recommendation: Pace activities, prioritize sleep, manage stress, and work with a specialist for symptom management.

food_poisoning.description: Food poisoning is an illness caused by eating contaminated food, leading to nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.
food_poisoning.recommendation: Stay hydrated, rest, avoid solid food until vomiting stops, and seek medical care if symptoms are severe.

whooping_cough.description: Whooping cough (pertussis) is a highly contagious bacterial infection causing severe coughing fits.
whooping_cough.recommendation: Seek medical treatment with antibiotics, stay isolated, and ensure vaccination for prevention.

scarlet_fever.description: Scarlet fever is a bacterial infection causing a distinctive red rash, high fever, and sore throat.
scarlet_fever.recommendation: Seek medical treatment with antibiotics, stay isolated, and maintain good hygiene.

celiac_disease.description: Celiac disease is an autoimmune disorder where ingesting gluten leads to damage in the small intestine.
celiac_disease.recommendation: Follow a strict gluten-free diet, take nutritional supplements, and monitor with a gastroenterologist.

hemorrhoids.description: Hemorrhoids are swollen veins in the lower rectum and anus, causing pain, itching, and bleeding.
hemorrhoids.recommendation: Increase fiber intake, use stool softeners, take sitz baths, and consult a doctor for persistent cases.
